children: Occupy, a launchpad from Virtuals Protocol, is now live on Base. Each token issued through the platform pairs with a tokenized stock, and 40% of fees flow into a stock treasury tied to that pairing. Holder-chosen AI Senates direct how each treasury is managed, and AI Senator registration is open now, with the first election to be announced.

The launch gives VIRTUAL a new demand driver tied to launchpad activity. Every issuance on Occupy creates a paired stock position, so future listing volume and trading fees translate directly into treasury building rather than remaining one-time fees. Governance also changes shape: token holders select AI Senators who manage each treasury, which adds a recurring participation loop around every launch. Repricing VIRTUAL would depend on how much issuance and secondary trading Occupy attracts, since both feed the fee stream behind the stock pairings. The first Senate election date has not been set, so near-term engagement rests on registration and upcoming announcements.

title: Virtuals Protocol: Occupy Launchpad Goes Live on Base - 15 Sep 2026
